description.value: The Johnson Bentley Memorial Aquatic Centre (JBMAC) is a publicly operated, accessible multi-use aquatic and fitness facility run by the City of West Kelowna, serving people of all ages and abilities. In addition to a swimming pool and weight room, it features a hot tub and steam room — amenities that touring cyclists finishing a long day in the saddle may find especially appealing. The facility operates under the motto 'Promote Safe Swimming and Healthy Lifestyles.'
